name: attendance
definition: 记录某成员参与某场活动这一事实的信息条目,以成员与活动的关联为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员对象混淆:成员是参与主体,参与记录是主体与活动之间的关联信息 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attendance; provenance: direct source attendance

name: budget
definition: 为某场活动按类别核定并跟踪支出与结余的财务计划信息条目,以类别、金额、已用与剩余为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与支出记录混淆:预算是事前核定的额度计划,支出是实际发生的费用记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table budget; provenance: direct source budget

name: event
definition: 在特定日期与地点发生、具有名称、类型与状态的集会性事件,以发生时间与地点为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与信息记录混淆:活动是实际发生的事件,预算与参与记录是描述该事件的信息条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table event; provenance: direct source event

name: expense
definition: 记录某成员在某日期发生、归属某预算并带审批状态的费用信息条目,以金额与审批标志为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与预算混淆:支出是已发生的实际费用,预算是事前核定的额度 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table expense; provenance: direct source expense

name: income
definition: 记录某成员在某日期收到、来自特定来源的款项信息条目,以到账日期与来源为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与费用支出混淆:收入是资金流入,支出是资金流出,两者方向相反 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table income; provenance: direct source income

name: major
definition: 高校中按院系与学院组织的学科培养方向,以所属院系与学院为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员混淆:专业是培养方向,成员是归属该方向的人员 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table major; provenance: direct source major

name: member
definition: 参与组织活动并具有姓名、职位、联系方式等属性的自然人,以所属专业与职位为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与专业混淆:成员是自然人,专业是其所属的培养方向 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table member; provenance: direct source member

name: zip_code
definition: 标识城市、县、州等行政区划的邮政编码信息条目,以所属城市与州为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员混淆:邮政编码是地址编码信息,成员是自然人 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table zip_code; provenance: direct source zip_code

name: MemberMajor
definition: The major a member is enrolled in.

name: MemberDepartment
definition: The department offering the member's major.

name: MemberCollege
definition: The college offering the member's major.

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: The t-shirt size of a member.

name: MemberPosition
definition: The position/role of a member in the organization.

name: EventName
definition: The name of an event.

name: EventType
definition: The type/category of an event.

name: EventStatus
definition: The status of an event (e.g., Closed, Open).

name: EventLocation
definition: The location where an event is held.

name: EventDate
definition: The date an event occurs.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: The category of a budget line item.

name: BudgetAmount
definition: The amount budgeted for a budget line item.

name: BudgetSpent
definition: The amount spent against a budget line item.

name: ExpenseCost
definition: The cost of an expense record.

name: ExpenseDescription
definition: The description of an expense.

name: ExpenseDate
definition: The date an expense was incurred.

name: IncomeAmount
definition: The amount of income received.

name: IncomeSource
definition: The source of income (e.g., Fundraising, Dues).

name: IncomeDateReceived
definition: The date income was received.

name: IncomeNotes
definition: Notes associated with an income record.

name: TotalBudgetAmount
definition: Sum of all budgeted amounts. Formula: SUM(BudgetAmount). Inputs: BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: TotalBudgetSpent
definition: Sum of all spent amounts. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpent). Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent

name: TotalExpenseCost
definition: Sum of all expense costs. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: TotalIncomeAmount
definition: Sum of all income amounts. Formula: SUM(IncomeAmount). Inputs: IncomeAmount = income.amount

name: BudgetVariance
definition: Difference between budgeted amount and spent amount. Formula: BudgetAmount - BudgetSpent. Inputs: BudgetAmount = budget.amount; BudgetSpent = budget.spent

name: YearOverYearSpentDifference
definition: Difference in total spent between two years. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpent for year1) - SUM(BudgetSpent for year2). Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent; EventDate = event.event_date

name: EventType
definition: Analysis of events by their type.

name: EventStatus
definition: Analysis of events by their status.

name: IncomeSource
definition: Analysis of income by source.

name: MemberPosition
definition: Analysis of members by position.

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: Analysis of members by t-shirt size.
